channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: South Africa mine collapse kills 14 suspected illegal miners
item.description: At least 14 suspected illegal miners were killed and eight injured when a mine dump collapsed in South Africa.

item.title: Ten police and 17 ‘bandits’ killed in firefight in northwestern Nigeria
item.description: Police say 17 suspected gang members and two civilians were also killed in Kebbi State.

item.title: War on Iran: Mojtaba Khamenei is in ‘perfect health’, Iran says
item.description: President Masoud Pezeshkian says Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei is in ‘perfect health’.

item.title: ‘Only job I know’: Philippine sailors return to sea despite wartime risks
item.description: Despite risks in the Strait of Hormuz and Black Sea, seafarers from the Philippines are still competing for jobs.

item.title: What are Saudi Arabia, Turkiye and Pakistan’s joint military capabilities?
item.description: The Mecca defence pact combines a top oil exporter, NATO's second-largest army and the only Muslim nuclear arsenal.

item.title: Trump hid in catering truck in secret plane swap over Iran threat, reports say
item.description: The US president was reportedly part of a ruse where reporters were falsely told he was with them on Air Force One leaving a Nato summit in Turkey.

item.title: Russia using North Korean missiles to strike Ukraine, Zelensky says
item.description: Ukraine's president says strikes in Zaporizhzhia - which killed seven people - involved ballistic missiles from Russia's ally.

item.title: Lebanon parliament votes to abolish death penalty
item.description: The new law - which next goes to the cabinet for approval - would make Lebanon the first country in the Middle East to end capital punishment.

item.title: Houthis reportedly kill four in first deadly attack since start of Iran war
item.description: The attack was reportedly carried out by Iranian proxy on a small cargo ship, as tensions in region over the US-Iran conflict remain high.

item.title: Watch: Was Trump smuggled out of Air Force One in a catering truck?
item.description: US media reports say the president secretly left via a catering truck to avoid a threat to his life from Iran.
